run_training_script: run the banding removal training script with the configured hyperparameters on a single GPU
run_multigpu_training: run the banding removal training script across multiple GPUs using spawn_dist
configure_var_net_trainer: configure the VarNetTrainer with method_str, sensitivity encoding, and adversarial training settings
configure_adversarial_training: configure orientation adversary training with shallow model, warmup, and strength parameters
configure_checkpoint_restart: configure model checkpoint restart from a pretrained model file for continued training
